description: A Flutter widget implementing a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard designed for DPAD navigation. It provides a modal dialog interface with custom focus management and key handling suitable for remote control devices.

classes.name: OnScreenKeyboard
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a full-screen on-screen keyboard with callbacks for submission, cancellation, and change events.

classes.name: _OnScreenKeyboardState
classes.description: The state class managing the layout, focus, and key handling logic for OnScreenKeyboard.

methods.name: OnScreenKeyboard.show
methods.description: Displays the keyboard as a modal dialog; returns the entered string or null if cancelled.
